processing_notes: Converted the geoph 2024 regions shapefile to GeoJSON; mapped source PSGC pcodes PH01-PH19 to PCA's 18 region identifiers; retained region-level MultiPolygon geometry; rounded coordinates to six decimal places; and sorted features by stable source pcode. The source is an unofficial analytical boundary dataset reconciled against the official PSA PSGC roster, not a legal or survey-grade government boundary product. This one current snapshot is intentionally applied to competition history from 2007 onward.
